preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string must only contain alphabetic characters and digits.
The string must not be empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(alphabetnums.get(c, c) if c.isalpha() else alphabet[int(c)-1] for c in s)
postconditions.description: The output string must be the inverse of the input string with letters converted to their numeric equivalents and numbers converted to their corresponding letters.
